titleInfo.title: Holding back the river
titleInfo.subTitle: the struggle against nature on America's waterways

titleInfo.title: Struggle against nature on America's waterways

originInfo.edition: First Avid Reader Press hardcover edition.

abstract.#text: Kelley brings us into the lives of the Americans wrestling to harness and preserve our mighty rivers and, through their stories, suggests solutions to some of the century's greatest challenges. --Adapted from publisher description.

mods.tableOfContents: Prelude: Perfecting nature -- Part one. The lock -- Part two. Alluvial empire -- Part three. Rivers of earth -- Coda: Retreat and fortify.
